about_the_game:
Send your heroes into glittering halls and shining altar rooms with the KR Crystal Castle Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a massive set of MV/MZ-sized tiles to help you build new locations for your players to enjoy and your heroes to explore. A2, A4, and A5 tiles along with 2 B sheets include all the walls, floors, and decorations you could need to create palace and church interiors. Have your heroes search a church chapel that had been cursed, where even the small flower beds by the doorway had been turned into hard jewels, or create mystical dungeons filled with pillars and crystal statues that form wherever magic levels grow too high.

Once crystal castle is already amazing, but what if you could have 10 different castles scattered around your world? This pack has you covered, with 10 different recolors to fit the mood you’re aiming for! Ruby, sunstone, topaz, emerald, aquamarine, sapphire, amethyst, rose quartz, onyx, and diamond versions can help you create a full rainbow of dungeons for your heroes to explore, or mix and match the sheets to create cool blue and green underwater palaces and deadly red and black lairs for the final boss. This pack’s 8 character sprites include 5 doors to help your heroes get inside the castle and search different rooms, while the decorative treasure chest can reward anyone who goes out of their way to explore and solve the dungeon’s puzzles. Use the 2 sheets of twinkles to highlight important points in a room, or use them just to make the maps even sparklier. So if you’ve been wanting to add some cool themed castles to your game, pick up the KR Crystal Castle Tileset!

The Crystal Castle Tileset Includes:

(in ALL TEN COLORS):

Ground tiles:
simple crystal ground and brighter path
large crystal tiled pattern
crystal "rug" pattern
chunky crystal path
crystal grass
crystal fences
and more! 15 crystal patterns in total.

Wall Tiles:
Includes wall versions of all the floors. Mix and match to make pillars, etc!

Also includes:
stairs that match the floors/walls
benches
altar
doors
pillars
crystal pieces
spikes
lion statues
swan statues
crystal orb
candlesticks and other small decorations
male and female statues
architectural pieces
16 stained glass pieces to match each color
and more!

Events and Animations
4 door events (with variations), treasure chest animation, and several styles of sparkles.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
